latest_release.body:
This release focuses on improving the desktop experience and chat navigation. Windows users will now have improved bundle origin permissions and chat reply links will open directly in the browser. It also includes a version update to 2026.10.1.

## What's Changed
* fix(desktop): grant bundle origins on Windows by @CuriousCorrelation in https://github.com/hoppscotch/hoppscotch/pull/6768
* fix(common): open chat reply links in the browser by @CuriousCorrelation in https://github.com/hoppscotch/hoppscotch/pull/6714
* chore: bump version to `2026.10.1` by @mirarifhasan in https://github.com/hoppscotch/hoppscotch/pull/6773


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hoppscotch/hoppscotch/compare/2026.10.0...2026.10.1
